local scn, done = ...
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local rows = {}
for _, w in ipairs(bot:GetWeapons()) do
  rows[#rows+1] = { class = w:GetClass(), slot = w:GetSlot(), pos = w:GetSlotPos(), name = w:GetPrintName(),
    base = w.Base or "", scripted = w:IsScripted() }
end
local active = IsValid(bot:GetActiveWeapon()) and bot:GetActiveWeapon():GetClass() or ""
-- the game's slot1..slot6 / invnext / invprev console commands on a bot: what the server does
local after = {}
local t, phase = 0, 0
local cmds = { "slot1", "slot1", "slot1", "slot1", "slot2", "slot3", "slot4", "slot5", "slot6", "invnext", "invnext", "invprev", "lastinv" }
hook.Add("Think", "parity_slots", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t % 10 == 0 then
    phase = phase + 1
    if cmds[phase] == nil then
      hook.Remove("Think", "parity_slots")
      done({ weapons = rows, active = active, after = after, fastswitch = GetConVar("hud_fastswitch") and GetConVar("hud_fastswitch"):GetString() or "" })
      return
    end
    bot:ConCommand(cmds[phase])
  elseif t % 10 == 5 and phase > 0 then
    after[#after+1] = { cmd = cmds[phase], active = IsValid(bot:GetActiveWeapon()) and bot:GetActiveWeapon():GetClass() or "" }
  end
end)
return "async"
